title: collab: rebuildDoc/cloneJson stack-overflow DoS bypasses 1350 inbound validation
description:
Adversarial QA of task 1350 (b188d66 validate/normalize inbound CRDT) found a DoS that 1350 does NOT close, despite its commit message claiming 'crashing every collaborator (DoS)' is addressed.

ROOT CAUSE. validateInboundDoc runs on the OUTPUT of rebuildDoc (binding.ts:79,96 — adopted = validateInboundDoc(rebuildDoc(ydoc), ...)). But rebuildDoc crashes FIRST. In packages/collab/src/ymap-fields.ts rebuildFields(), every ATOMIC (non-structural) field is read with cloneJson(ymap.get(key)) (packages/collab/src/json.ts cloneJson is a recursive plain-JSON deep clone). A peer can store a Y.Map or Y.Array as the value of any atomic field; ymap.get returns the LIVE Yjs object, and cloneJson recurses through Yjs's cyclic internal item graph -> 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded'. This throws inside the binding's observeDeep observer (binding.ts:93) BEFORE validateInboundDoc is ever called, so the new validation cannot catch it.

SCOPE (all crash; verified). A Y.Map/Y.Array stored as the value of an atomic field at ANY level crashes rebuildDoc: doc-level (properties, id, any custom field — note properties is NOT in DOC_STRUCTURAL, schema.ts:40), display-object fields (e.g. x), scene/layer/frame fields, library-item fields. Reachable end-to-end through the real FlashCollabBinding inbound observer via normal Yjs replication (Y.applyUpdate of the malicious peer's state) — i.e. any peer with the share link can crash every collaborator (DoS), the exact threat 1350 claims to defend.

WHAT 1350 DOES catch (verified, has teeth via counterfactual vs bare rebuildDoc): plain-JSON hostile values — unknown display-object type / library itemType dropped, missing-id dropped, NaN/Infinity coords coerced, non-array scenes/layers/displayObjects replaced, absurd doc properties clamped, oversized arrays bounded (100k), deep plain-JSON nesting depth-bounded, and asClasses path traversal/NUL/absolute rejected via normalizeClassPath. Those are genuinely closed. The ONLY residual is the Y-type-in-atomic-field crash that happens upstream in rebuildDoc.

FIX DIRECTION (collab-package only; do NOT change the importer/core). Harden rebuildDoc/cloneJson against non-plain-JSON (Yjs) values in atomic slots BEFORE/INSTEAD of the unbounded recursive clone: e.g. in rebuildFields, when an atomic value is a Y.AbstractType (Y.Map/Y.Array/Y.Text) treat it as malformed and drop/coerce it (a well-formed doc never stores a Y-type in an atomic field — atomic fields are materialized via cloneJson of plain JSON, so this is a pure hardening with no valid-doc behavior change), OR give cloneJson a depth/visited bound so it cannot stack-overflow. Then re-run the adversarial cases.

REPRO (node, in packages/collab after build):
  import * as Y from 'yjs'; import { rebuildDoc } from './dist/schema.js';
  const yd=new Y.Doc(); const r=yd.getMap('doc');
  yd.transact(()=>{ r.set('id','doc'); r.set('properties', new Y.Map()); },{wire:'remote'});
  rebuildDoc(yd); // RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
Also reachable through FlashCollabBinding: applyUpdate(localYDoc, encodeStateAsUpdate(maliciousYDoc), {wire:'remote'}) throws in the observer.

ACCEPTANCE: a Y.Map/Y.Array stored in any atomic field at any node level must NOT crash rebuildDoc or the binding inbound observer; it must be dropped/coerced and the live FlashDocument stay valid. Add to packages/collab/src/__tests__/validate.test.ts (or a new rebuild-hardening test) the doc-level + display-object-level Y-type-in-atomic cases driven through the real binding. Existing collab tests (binding/property/validate, 22) must stay green; valid-doc convergence + identity unaffected.

Found during 1350 verification (read-only); no product code changed by the QA pass.
